editorial:
If you love superhero movies with a twist, this one is for you. It follows a brilliant but arrogant surgeon whose hands are ruined in a car crash. Desperate for a cure, he travels to Nepal and meets a powerful sorcerer who teaches him magic. The movie has a fun, trippy vibe with stunning visuals and a hero who learns to be less selfish. You'll enjoy the mix of humor and action as Strange goes from a cocky doctor to a defender of the world against dark forces.

Benedict Cumberbatch shines as Strange, bringing charm and wit to the role. The action scenes are creative, with buildings folding and time bending in wild ways. The pacing keeps you hooked from start to finish. On the downside, the villain feels a bit flat and the story follows a familiar origin formula. Still, it's a great pick for Marvel fans and anyone who enjoys fantasy adventure. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Strange traps the villain Dormammu in a time loop using the Time Stone. Every time Dormammu kills him, time resets and Strange comes back. Eventually Dormammu gets tired of the endless loop and agrees to leave Earth alone. Strange then becomes the new protector of his magical sanctuary. The twist is that Strange wins not by fighting harder, but by being willing to die over and over until his enemy gives up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero movies and fantasy adventures.
